title: PredictBot betting ledger -- one JSON object per line (JSONL), append-only
description: Every line is ONE TICKET EVENT for exactly one ticket_id. A ticket's current state is the merge of every event recorded for its ticket_id, in file order. Legs are nested inside the PLACED event's own payload -- never duplicated per leg as separate top-level records -- so total_stake is recorded exactly once per ticket regardless of leg or combination count. Every money field (unit_stake/total_stake/max_return/placed_odds/actual_return/profit_loss) is a DECIMAL STRING (e.g. "10.00"), never a JSON number -- a JSON number round-trips through a binary float in most parsers, which this repository's own code (ledgers/money.py) refuses outright.

combination_count.description: null exactly when stake_structure_basis is TOTAL_ONLY_UNKNOWN_BREAKDOWN -- the combinatorial structure was never known, so there is no combination count to report.

unit_stake.description: null when stake_buckets is present (a real per-fold-size stake breakdown, not one uniform scalar -- see stake_buckets) or when stake_structure_basis is TOTAL_ONLY_UNKNOWN_BREAKDOWN.

stake_structure_basis.description: Present only for a SYSTEM ticket built with stake_structure_known=False: total_stake is a trusted, bookmaker-reported figure, but the internal fold-size/combination breakdown could not be reconstructed at all (neither a real stake_buckets field nor a derivable unit_stake). Such a ticket can only ever be settled via settle_bookmaker_observed, never settle_computed. Absent for every ticket with a real, known structure (uniform unit_stake or stake_buckets) -- not a three-way enum here, just present-or-absent.

stake_buckets.description: Structured per-fold-size stake breakdown for a real Bet9ja SYSTEM ticket whose bucket unit stakes differ (e.g. Singles at one stake, Doubles at another) -- never derived from system_table_raw text; only ever built from an already-structured source. See ledgers/betting_ledger.py::_validate_stake_buckets.

source_raw.description: The exact original capture record this event was built from, preserved verbatim for audit -- never read by this module itself.

source_raw_hash.description: Content hash of the exact original capture record, for provenance/dedup auditing independent of this module's own natural key.

max_return.description: null when a historical ticket is imported after it already settled and no pre-settlement maximum-return figure was ever captured -- the ticket's real, final actual_return (see the SETTLED payload's settlement_basis) is what matters then, not a never-realized upper bound. Every other ticket carries a real value here.

forecast_id.description: null when this leg could not be linked to an exact canonical forecast identity -- a real wager is still recorded either way; missing forecast coverage never blocks recording an actual ticket.

settlement_basis.description: Optional, and absent on every settlement recorded before this field existed (preserving byte-identical re-settlement of historical rows). COMPUTED_FROM_SELECTIONS: actual_return was replayed from leg_results against the ticket's own combinatorial structure and per-leg odds (settle_computed). BOOKMAKER_OBSERVED: actual_return is the bookmaker's own reported final figure, taken verbatim and never recomputed (settle_bookmaker_observed) -- used for a historical ticket whose internal stake structure may be partly or wholly unknown, and preferred even when the structure IS known, since a real bookmaker figure already reflects voids/promotions/rounding a pure replay cannot see.

settled_at_resolution.description: Present only when settled_at_utc is not the true settlement moment but an upper bound on it (e.g. "CAPTURE_TIME_UPPER_BOUND" -- the capture's own captured_at_utc, used because the source capture never recorded a real settlement timestamp). Absent whenever settled_at_utc is the real, known settlement time.
